findings.body: getSubGroupsCount() returns null even though GroupModel specifies that it never returns null; downstream callers can fail when unboxing the result, and admin representations can expose a missing subgroup count.
findings.failure_mode: Concurrent deletion produces an invalid model/API value instead of preserving the GroupModel contract.
findings.impact: getSubGroupsCount() returns null even though GroupModel specifies that it never returns null; downstream callers can fail when unboxing the result, and admin representations can expose a missing subgroup count.
findings.root_cause: The new null fallback converts a missing backing model directly into a null GroupModel count.
findings.suggested_fix: Return a non-null value such as 0L when the backing model is absent, or handle the deleted group before invoking this contract method.
findings.title: getSubGroupsCount violates the non-null GroupModel contract
findings.trigger: A cached group is deleted before modelSupplier.get() resolves the backing model, causing the supplier to return null.
findings.verifier_reason: Patch line 275 verbatim shows `return model == null ? null : model.getSubGroupsCount();`. GroupModel.java:298 documents `@return The number of groups beneath this group. Never returns {@code null}.` The patch explicitly returns null when model is null, violating this contract. Callers like GroupUtils.populateSubGroupCount pass the result to setSubGroupCount which accepts Long, and downstream unboxing or API consumers expecting non-null will fail.

pr.title: Fix NPE when accessing group concurrently

raw_findings.impact: getSubGroupsCount() returns null even though GroupModel specifies that it never returns null; downstream callers can fail when unboxing the result, and admin representations can expose a missing subgroup count.
raw_findings.root_cause: The new null fallback converts a missing backing model directly into a null GroupModel count.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Return a non-null value such as 0L when the backing model is absent, or handle the deleted group before invoking this contract method.
raw_findings.title: getSubGroupsCount violates the non-null GroupModel contract
raw_findings.trigger: A cached group is deleted before modelSupplier.get() resolves the backing model, causing the supplier to return null.

raw_findings.body: The test can pass without exercising any read/delete overlap, leaving the concurrent NPE regression untested.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Scheduling variance makes the concurrency test vacuous and permits regressions to pass.
raw_findings.impact: The test can pass without exercising any read/delete overlap, leaving the concurrent NPE regression untested.
raw_findings.root_cause: The reader thread is started without a readiness handshake with the deleting thread.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Signal reader readiness with a CountDownLatch before starting deletion, and await that signal before executing the delete loop.
raw_findings.title: Concurrency test can complete deletion before the reader starts
raw_findings.trigger: The scheduler allows the test thread to perform all group deletions before the newly started reader thread gets CPU time or sends its first request.

raw_findings.body: The assertion can pass before a concurrent failure is recorded, and the reader can continue issuing requests after the test method returns.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Failures occurring after the assertion become false negatives and can leak activity into subsequent tests.
raw_findings.impact: The assertion can pass before a concurrent failure is recorded, and the reader can continue issuing requests after the test method returns.
raw_findings.root_cause: The test checks the shared exception list without waiting for the asynchronous reader to complete.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Retain the Thread reference, set the stop flag, join the reader with a bounded timeout, and only then assert that caughtExceptions is empty.
raw_findings.title: Concurrency test asserts before the reader thread has finished
raw_findings.trigger: The reader is still processing an HTTP request or has caught an exception but has not yet appended it when this assertion runs.

raw_findings.body: deletedAll remains false and the non-daemon reader loops indefinitely, potentially hanging the test suite and continuing HTTP requests.
raw_findings.failure_mode: Exceptional test paths leave an infinite background thread running.
raw_findings.impact: deletedAll remains false and the non-daemon reader loops indefinitely, potentially hanging the test suite and continuing HTTP requests.
raw_findings.root_cause: Reader shutdown is performed only after successful completion of the deletion loop rather than in guaranteed cleanup.
raw_findings.suggested_fix: Move the stop signal into a finally block around the deletion and use a retained thread reference to interrupt or join the reader during cleanup.
raw_findings.title: Reader thread is not stopped when deletion fails
raw_findings.trigger: Any group deletion request throws an exception before normal control reaches this line.

finding.title: Reader thread is not stopped when deletion fails
finding.trigger: Any group deletion request throws an exception before normal control reaches this line.
finding.verifier_reason: Patch line 155 shows `deletedAll.set(true);` only reached after successful completion of the forEach deletion loop at lines 152-154. If any deletion throws an exception, deletedAll remains false and the reader thread at lines 139-148 loops indefinitely since it checks `!deletedAll.get()`. No finally block or cleanup ensures the thread stops.
